definition_en: to give up something completely
example_en: Bad weather forced the climbers to [abandon] their attempt to reach the summit.
example_zh: 恶劣天气迫使登山者放弃了登顶的尝试。

definition_en: the right or chance to use something
example_en: Every student should have [access] to the library after class.
example_zh: 每个学生课后都应该能使用图书馆。

definition_en: to keep something at the same level
example_en: It is not easy to [maintain] a healthy diet during exam season.
example_zh: 考试季保持健康饮食并不容易。

definition_en: large or important enough to be noticed
example_en: There has been a [significant] increase in online shopping.
example_zh: 网购出现了显著增长。

definition_en: a way of dealing with something
example_en: We need a fresh [approach] to the problem of traffic jams.
example_zh: 我们需要用新方法解决交通拥堵问题。

definition_en: to come nearer to something
example_en: Please slow down as you [approach] the school gate.
example_zh: 接近校门时请减速。

definition_en: an important topic that people discuss
example_en: Climate change is a global [issue] that no country can ignore.
example_zh: 气候变化是任何国家都不能忽视的全球问题。

definition_en: to officially give or announce something
example_en: The government will [issue] new guidelines next month.
example_zh: 政府下个月将发布新指南。

definition_en: facts that show something is true
example_en: There is little [evidence] that the drug works.
example_zh: 几乎没有证据表明这种药有效。

definition_en: to give something to help achieve a result
example_en: Everyone in the team is expected to [contribute] ideas.
example_zh: 团队中每个人都应贡献想法。

definition_en: an advantage that something gives you
example_en: One [benefit] of living in the city is easy transport.
example_zh: 住在城市的一个好处是交通便利。

definition_en: extremely important
example_en: Sleep is [crucial] for memory and learning.
example_zh: 睡眠对记忆和学习至关重要。

definition_en: having more than one possible meaning
example_en: The instructions were so [ambiguous] that nobody knew what to do.
example_zh: 说明含糊不清，没人知道该做什么。

definition_en: to expect that something will happen
example_en: We did not [anticipate] such a large crowd at the concert.
example_zh: 我们没料到音乐会有这么多人。

definition_en: an agreement in which each side gives up something
example_en: After hours of debate, the two sides reached a [compromise].
example_zh: 经过数小时辩论，双方达成了妥协。

definition_en: a result of an action
example_en: Rising sea levels are one [consequence] of global warming.
example_zh: 海平面上升是全球变暖的后果之一。

definition_en: done on purpose
example_en: It was not an accident but a [deliberate] attempt to mislead the public.
example_zh: 这不是意外，而是蓄意误导公众。

definition_en: to remove something completely
example_en: The new design aims to [eliminate] unnecessary steps.
example_zh: 新设计旨在消除不必要的步骤。

definition_en: to appear or become known
example_en: New problems may [emerge] as the project grows.
example_zh: 随着项目发展可能出现新问题。

definition_en: easily broken or damaged
example_en: Please handle the box carefully; the glass inside is [fragile].
example_zh: 请小心搬运箱子，里面的玻璃易碎。

definition_en: certain to happen
example_en: Some mistakes are [inevitable] when you learn a new language.
example_zh: 学习新语言时有些错误是不可避免的。

definition_en: to become stronger or more extreme
example_en: The storm is expected to [intensify] overnight.
example_zh: 预计风暴将在夜间加剧。

definition_en: an idea or belief
example_en: The [notion] that money brings happiness is too simple.
example_zh: 金钱带来幸福的观念过于简单。

definition_en: not clear or difficult to understand
example_en: The meaning of the old poem remains [obscure] to most readers.
example_zh: 这首古诗的含义对大多数读者仍然模糊难懂。

definition_en: to continue doing something despite difficulty
example_en: If you [persist] in practising every day, you will improve.
example_zh: 如果你坚持每天练习，就会进步。

definition_en: not willing to do something
example_en: She was [reluctant] to share her notes with others.
example_zh: 她不愿意和别人分享笔记。

definition_en: to throw or spread things over an area
example_en: The wind began to [scatter] the leaves across the yard.
example_zh: 风开始把树叶吹散到院子各处。

definition_en: easily hurt or harmed
example_en: Young children are especially [vulnerable] to the flu.
example_zh: 幼儿特别容易感染流感。

definition_en: to take money out of an account; to take back
example_en: You can [withdraw] money from the machine at any time.
example_zh: 你可以随时从机器上取钱。

definition_en: an organization that keeps and lends money
example_en: I need to go to the [bank] to open an account.
example_zh: 我得去银行开个账户。

definition_en: the land along the side of a river
example_en: We had a picnic on the [bank] of the river.
example_zh: 我们在河岸上野餐。

definition_en: treating people equally
example_en: It is not [fair] to judge people by their looks.
example_zh: 以貌取人是不公平的。

definition_en: an event where people show or sell goods
example_en: The town holds a book [fair] every spring.
example_zh: 镇上每年春天举办书展。

definition_en: not being used; free
example_en: What do you like to do in your [spare] time?
example_zh: 你空闲时喜欢做什么？

definition_en: to give time or money to someone
example_en: Could you [spare] a few minutes to help me?
example_zh: 你能抽出几分钟帮我吗？

definition_en: to gradually get more of something
example_en: It takes years to [accumulate] enough experience in this field.
example_zh: 在这个领域积累足够经验需要数年。

definition_en: to give something for a particular purpose
example_en: The manager will [allocate] tasks to each member.
example_zh: 经理会给每个成员分配任务。

definition_en: to think something is true without proof
example_en: Don't [assume] that everyone agrees with you.
example_zh: 不要假定每个人都同意你。

definition_en: to take on a responsibility or role
example_en: She will [assume] responsibility for the new department.
example_zh: 她将负责新部门。

definition_en: clear and logically connected
example_en: A good essay presents a [coherent] argument.
example_zh: 好文章提出连贯的论证。

definition_en: to form an idea in your mind
example_en: It is hard to [conceive] of a world without the internet.
example_zh: 很难想象没有互联网的世界。

definition_en: public disagreement about something
example_en: The new law caused great [controversy] among scientists.
example_zh: 新法律在科学家中引起了巨大争议。

definition_en: to become smaller or fewer
example_en: Sales began to [decline] after the price increase.
example_zh: 涨价后销量开始下降。

definition_en: to politely refuse
example_en: He had to [decline] the invitation because he was busy.
example_zh: 他因为忙不得不谢绝邀请。

definition_en: to become or make less
example_en: Nothing could [diminish] her enthusiasm for research.
example_zh: 没有什么能减弱她对研究的热情。

definition_en: to recognize the difference between things
example_en: Can you [distinguish] between the two sounds?
example_zh: 你能区分这两个声音吗？

definition_en: to describe something as bigger than it is
example_en: To sell more copies, some newspapers [exaggerate] small dangers.
example_zh: 为了多卖报纸，有些报纸会夸大小风险。

definition_en: forming the base of something
example_en: Freedom of speech is a [fundamental] right.
example_zh: 言论自由是一项基本权利。

definition_en: an idea that is tested by research
example_en: The experiment was designed to test a [hypothesis] about memory.
example_zh: 该实验旨在检验一个关于记忆的假说。

definition_en: a possible effect or meaning
example_en: What is the [implication] of these results for teachers?
example_zh: 这些结果对教师意味着什么？

definition_en: something that encourages you to act
example_en: Lower taxes give companies an [incentive] to invest.
example_zh: 降低税收给企业投资的动力。

definition_en: to show that something is reasonable
example_en: How can you [justify] spending so much on a phone?
example_zh: 你如何证明在手机上花这么多钱是合理的？

definition_en: to control someone or something unfairly
example_en: Some advertisements try to [manipulate] our emotions.
example_zh: 有些广告试图操纵我们的情绪。

definition_en: coming before the main part
example_en: The [preliminary] results look promising.
example_zh: 初步结果看起来很有希望。

definition_en: doubting that something is true
example_en: Many experts remain [skeptical] about the claim.
example_zh: 许多专家对这一说法仍持怀疑态度。

definition_en: to gradually make something weaker
example_en: Constant criticism can [undermine] a child's confidence.
example_zh: 不断的批评会削弱孩子的自信。

definition_en: to produce a result
example_en: This method can [yield] better results in less time.
example_zh: 这种方法能在更短时间内产生更好的结果。

definition_en: to stop resisting
example_en: The government refused to [yield] to public pressure.
example_zh: 政府拒绝向公众压力让步。

definition_en: a place to live or stay
example_en: The university helps new students find [accommodation] near campus.
example_zh: 大学帮助新生在校园附近找到住处。

definition_en: to examine something in detail
example_en: Students learn to [analyse] poems in this course.
example_zh: 学生在这门课上学习分析诗歌。

definition_en: the way someone acts
example_en: The teacher praised the children for their good [behaviour].
example_zh: 老师表扬了孩子们的良好表现。

definition_en: a person you work with
example_en: I often have lunch with a [colleague] from the marketing team.
example_zh: 我常和市场部的一位同事吃午饭。

definition_en: to travel regularly between home and work
example_en: Many people [commute] to the city by train every day.
example_zh: 许多人每天乘火车通勤进城。

definition_en: the subjects taught at a school
example_en: Coding has become part of the school [curriculum].
example_zh: 编程已经成为学校课程的一部分。

definition_en: a time by which something must be done
example_en: The [deadline] for the application is next Friday.
example_zh: 申请截止日期是下周五。

definition_en: the natural world around us
example_en: We should protect the [environment] for future generations.
example_zh: 我们应为子孙后代保护环境。

definition_en: a building or equipment for a purpose
example_en: The new sports [facility] is open to the public.
example_zh: 新的体育设施向公众开放。

definition_en: to complete a university degree
example_en: She plans to [graduate] from university next summer.
example_zh: 她计划明年夏天大学毕业。

definition_en: a person who has finished a degree
example_en: Every [graduate] of the program receives a certificate.
example_zh: 该项目的每位毕业生都会获得证书。

definition_en: the natural home of an animal or plant
example_en: Cutting down forests destroys the natural [habitat] of many animals.
example_zh: 砍伐森林破坏了许多动物的自然栖息地。

definition_en: a plan of a journey
example_en: Our travel agent sent us a detailed [itinerary] for the trip.
example_zh: 旅行社给我们发来了详细的行程。

definition_en: everything you can see in an area of land
example_en: The mountain [landscape] attracts thousands of hikers.
example_zh: 山地风景吸引了成千上万的徒步者。

definition_en: an area of a town where people live
example_en: It is a quiet [neighbourhood] with many parks.
example_zh: 这是个有很多公园的安静街区。

definition_en: harmful substances in air, water or soil
example_en: Air [pollution] is a serious problem in big cities.
example_zh: 空气污染是大城市的严重问题。

definition_en: to treat waste so it can be used again
example_en: We [recycle] paper, glass and plastic at home.
example_zh: 我们在家回收纸、玻璃和塑料。

definition_en: a plan of times for events
example_en: Let me check my [schedule] before I agree to the meeting.
example_zh: 同意开会前我先查看一下日程。

definition_en: money paid for teaching
example_en: Many students take part-time jobs to pay their [tuition].
example_zh: 许多学生做兼职来支付学费。

definition_en: a person who works without being paid
example_en: She works as a [volunteer] at the local hospital.
example_zh: 她在当地医院当志愿者。

definition_en: to plan and arrange an event
example_en: The students will [organise] a charity concert.
example_zh: 学生们将组织一场慈善音乐会。
